verification.note: Record read 2026-10-27 (fetch summary): born 1950; Ngāti Awa and Ngāti Porou; Dip. Teaching and BA 1975, MA 1987, PhD in Education 1996 (Auckland); senior lecturer 1987 (full-time 1991), associate professor 1997, director IRI 1998–2002, personal chair 2001, joint director Ngā Pae o te Māramatanga 2002; Churchill Fellowship 1991, Te Tohu Pae Tawhiti 1998, CNZM 2013, NZARE McKenzie Award 2015; publications include Decolonizing Methodologies (1999; 2nd ed. 2012) and, with Judith Simon, A Civilising Mission? (2001).
